answer: Missed seat leak: a grader who leaves an assigned seat unsealed at close loses 0.5 percent of bond times the square of consecutive misses, so 4 misses in a row cost 8 percent. Marble is that miss counter, reset by one sealed seat. Slashed bond waits in the Karst pool for 3 epochs and returns if the grader then seals 12 seats straight. Ocean is the full panel of 7 seats per row; a miss counts only if 4 other seats sealed. Failure mode: skipping only hard rows. Check rule: compare skip rate against median row length. Cheapest bypass: rotate wallets unless a shared funding tree links them.
